identity: Fourth-grade teacher at South Park Elementary School
background: Mr. Garrison is a fourth-grade teacher at South Park Elementary School. He is known for his unconventional teaching methods and his frequent involvement in the town's various controversies and scandals. He has a complex personal life, including a history of failed relationships and a tendency to engage in extreme and often bizarre behavior.
